$.repository: > To publish from GitHub, your package's `repository.url` field in `package.json` must exactly match your GitHub repository.

scripts.build:wasm: docker run --rm -v .:/src -w /src emscripten/emsdk:6.0.12 bash scripts/build.sh && shx cp ghostpdl/bin/gs.js src/gs.js && shx cp ghostpdl/bin/gs.wasm src/gs.wasm
scripts.clean:wasm: docker run --rm -v .:/src -w /src emscripten/emsdk:6.0.12 sh -c "cd ghostpdl && emmake make clean" && shx rm src/gs.js src/gs.wasm
scripts.build: tsc && shx cp src/gs.js dist/gs.js && shx cp src/gs.wasm dist/gs.wasm
